lines.text: Many learners say: He said a lie.
Tell! Do not tell a lie.

native.tip: 中文说“说谎”，“说”对应 say，所以容易说 say a lie。英语的固定说法是 tell a lie。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He said a lie.”😅 “说谎”的“说”不是 say，英语固定说 tell a lie：“He told a lie.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“He told a lie.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: The set phrase is tell a lie, not say a lie.
en.caption: Do you say “He said a lie.” 😅 The set phrase is tell a lie, not say a lie: “He told a lie.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
